gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed, newly diagnosed de-novo supratentorial glioblastoma (including gliosarcoma)

candidate_evidence.quote: The NeAT Glio trial will evaluate whether the addition of ipilimumab prior to the current standard treatment of surgery and chemoradiotherapy will improve survival in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Trial of Neoadjuvant Therapy in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: 3mg/kg Ipilimumab IV infusion (day 1) given as a 21 day cycle for 2 cycles.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Ipilimumab is a monoclonal antibody medication that works to activate the immune system by targeting CTLA-4, a protein receptor that downregulates the immune system.

coder_notes: Neoadjuvant ipilimumab (2 cycles) before standard surgery and chemoradiotherapy; the trial treatment is ipilimumab alone, standard chemoradiotherapy follows after trial treatment and its drug (presumably temozolomide) is not named, so not listed and regimen coded monotherapy. Patients donate tumour material and serial blood samples but no pharmacodynamic or PK endpoint is registered, so target engagement and tumour PK coded no.
